bio: Elected to the 17th Congress in April 1821 but died before taking his seat; Assembly member for Ulster (1804-05) and Orange (1820) ([R4-S1]). His parents are still not documented; no Tuthill genealogy consulted names them (Akerly 1898 has no Selah).
